description: Engineer professional-grade brand logos using geometric primitives and negative space - minimalist, scalable marks via muapi.ai (Flux).

inputs.name: concept
inputs.description: Core visual concept, e.g. "geometric security shield with a spark".

phases.prompt: Write a Geometric Minimalist logo brief for brand '{{brand}}', concept '{{concept}}', style '{{style}}', color palette '{{color}}'. Reduce the concept to at most 3 core geometric primitives (circle/square/triangle). Explicitly instruct use of negative space for a secondary meaning. Specify: solid colors, monochromatic/dual-tone palette, flat design only - no gradients, no 3D, no textures. Composition: isolated on a solid white background, perfectly centered, legible from 16px favicon to billboard. Render the brand name in clean, accurate typography. No mockups (t-shirts, business cards, desks).
